{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored wool-blend blazer in deep forest green (#0f3d3e) with a relaxed yet structured fit that hits just below the hip.
High-waisted pleated midi skirt in charcoal grey (#36454f) offering fluid movement while maintaining a polished silhouette.
Classic pointed-toe ankle boots in oxblood leather (#590b12) to ground the monochrome look with warmth for autumn weather.
Silk scarf in rust orange (#e07a5f) tied loosely at the neck to introduce a vibrant accent that complements her skin tones.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance between professional authority and approachable style, adhering strictly to the office setting while respecting the request for a neat dress code. The earthy palette of greens, greys, and oxblood harmonizes beautifully with her natural features, creating a cohesive and sophisticated ensemble without feeling overly rigid. By incorporating textured fabrics like wool and silk, the look elevates standard workwear into something refined yet comfortable enough for an entire day in the office."}
